definitions.explanation: Feeling uncomfortable and embarrassed because one has been caught out, made a blunder, or is in a situation where one does not know how to act.

examples.japanese: ばつが{悪|わる}い⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{嘘|うそ}→嘘：01796_uso⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ばれて→ばれる：06721_bareru⟧、ばつが{悪|わる}かった。
examples.english: I felt sheepish when my lie came out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{悪口|わるぐち}→悪口：12672_waruguchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}っている→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}ってきて→入ってくる：29060_haittekuru⟧、⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧ばつが{悪|わる}そう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{黙|だま}った→黙る：02287_damaru⟧。
examples.english: The person we were talking about walked in mid-gossip, and everyone fell into an embarrassed silence.

notes:
An everyday idiom. It works like an i-adjective: ばつが{悪|わる}そう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (looking embarrassed), ばつが{悪|わる}くて (feeling awkward, so …).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ばつが{悪|わる}い⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to feel awkward
- ばつが{悪|わる}そうな⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧: a sheepish look
- ばつが{悪|わる}そう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{笑|わら}う→笑う：00685_warau⟧: to laugh sheepishly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{気|き}まずい→気まずい：06536_kimazui⟧: awkward, uncomfortable, of a mood between people
- ⟦{恥|は}ずかしい→恥ずかしい：00843_hazukashii⟧: embarrassed, ashamed, the general word

WATCH OUT:
- This ばつ is often traced to {場都合|ばつごう} (the fit of the situation), not the ばつ of ×, the wrong-answer mark.
